description: Found in defk-9p6.13 (cosine_topk.exs). matmul.exs says EXLA was not measured because {:exla, "0.10.0"} did not compile on this machine (xla_extension headers vs Apple clang -Winvalid-specialization). {:nx, "== 0.13.1"}, {:exla, "== 0.13.1"} installs and compiles in ~25 s on the same machine (precompiled XLA 0.10.0 aarch64-darwin-cpu; exla 0.13.1 passes -Wno-invalid-specialization itself), and cosine_topk.exs uses it. matmul's header and README row ('EXLA's BLAS ... did not compile, not measured') can now be measured: add an EXLA row (Nx.Defn.jit with compiler: EXLA, tensors on EXLA.Backend) to matmul.exs and update the recommendation with a number.
title: Re-measure matmul.exs with EXLA 0.13.1: it compiles here now
